## Feature Proposal
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or model architecture.

## Motivation & Use Case
What problem does this solve or what capability does it add to the foundation models benchmark? (e.g. open-vocabulary object detection, semantic image retrieval, zero-shot depth estimation).

## Proposed Architecture / Method
Explain how this model or method would be integrated:
- Model repository / Hub source (e.g., Hugging Face, PyTorch Hub)
- Input/output tensor formats and preprocessing requirements
- Downstream task evaluation strategy

## Alternatives Considered
What alternatives have you evaluated?

## References & Papers
Links to arXiv papers, official model repositories, or documentation.
